messages.text: Remember these standing handoff preferences, keeping their scopes distinct: client handoffs should use exactly two concise bullets and at most 45 words in total; internal technical handoffs should use two short sections headed Overview and Risks, with a cause-and-effect explanation of each risk. Keep these preferences for future sessions and confirm the save. Do not take business action.

Draft a client handoff for a sensor dashboard that is installed and awaiting calibration. Follow my saved client-handoff preference. Mention installation and the remaining calibration work. Read only: do not change memory or take business action.

Draft an internal technical handoff for the same kind of sensor dashboard: installation is complete, calibration is pending, and uncalibrated readings may be misleading. Follow my saved internal-handoff preference; explain why pending calibration is a risk. Read only: do not change memory or take business action.
